title: Boyd's OODA: Resetting the Executive Freeze
hook: Task paralysis occurs when the Orientation phase gets trapped in analytical entropy.
core_insight: Col. John Boyd identified 'Orientation' as the core genetic code of decision loops. When ADHD induces freeze, the loop stalls because the brain seeks total certainty before acting. Speed outpaces precision: take the smallest irreversible step to shatter orientation paralysis and force the environment to reveal new data.
takeaways: Collapse loop latency: A 70% complete decision executed in 3 minutes beats a 100% decision delayed by an hour.
Small decisive actions dissolve internal friction faster than rumination.
